_doc: The independent reviewer's open-weight models, run on the Actions runner itself (zero API cost, no key). PROTECTED. The workflow runs the Ollama archive only when its sha256 matches `archive_sha256`; a model is asked only when the sha256 of its manifest file on disk matches its `digest`. A null or changed pin means nothing runs and the review queues (REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE). Pin each value from the 'archive sha256' and 'manifest sha256' lines a review run prints. `votes`: the family PASSes a review needs. zuck 2026-11-03 16:22Z (journal D-20261103-003): llama3.1:8b FAILed 25 of the 25 newest heads, every one the Auditor read clean, so it is unpinned and votes is 1; the injection and risk-word screens still run before any model, and risk-invariants and replay-shadow still gate every AUTO merge.
